suite.description: Given a request, which capabilities did the harness make reachable, how far away were they, and what did the rest cost? Every arm imports the same corpus into whatever shape it likes, and is scored only on what reached the assembled call.

notes: Every task received the same tools, because nothing installed here decides what to attach per query. So recall is one by construction and means nothing; precision and the wasted bytes are the real figures, and they are the headroom a tool-attention package would have.
